description: Turn a text prompt into a textured, downloadable 3D model (GLB). Free and keyless. Describe a SINGLE object, character, or creature: "a brass mid-century desk lamp", not a whole scene. Returns the model URL plus links that open it in the viewer, in the user's room through their phone camera, and in the AR studio. Use kind:"avatar" for a character: it comes back rigged, so it idles and animates instead of standing in a T-pose.

kind.description: model (a prop, default), avatar (a rigged character), or mesh (art-directed, prompt refined first).

prompt.description: The single object or character to model.

name: generate_3d_model
title: Generate a 3D model from text
